cache_contract.identity: TemporalCompressor object + immutable original wkv_/wgate_ Tensor members + successful finish generation
cache_contract.original_bindings: No original checkpoint Tensor or binding is reassigned; cache tensors are direct owned members.
cache_contract.generation: Publish after both original registered Cast operations and successful sync; verify both generation equality and owner/device/type/shape before reuse; ready guard rejects before-finish and duplicate finish.
cache_contract.mutation: Existing production finish freezes weights; arbitrary external mutation through escaped Tensor storage is outside this immutable contract. A future reload API must invalidate/recast via a new load generation; this package adds no reload API.
cache_contract.reset: Sequence reset preserves converted immutable weights; object destruction owns cache release. Exception path drains before local tensors destruct.
cache_contract.controller: mode0 original per-forward Cast, mode1 cached projection; switch only at quiescent boundaries. Cache allocated at finish in both arms. Default mode0.
cache_contract.counters: Each owner field0 accumulates load Casts(2 per HCA=40 at finish), field1 cached projection uses(40 per full C1 decode), field2 uncached projection uses(40 per full C1 decode). No counter resets; use deltas.
